mapper.select: SELECT hcn.id, hcn.user_id, u.name AS user_name, hcn.consultation_date, hcn.consultant_name, hcn.topic, hcn.content, hcn.action_items, hcn.created_at FROM tb_health_consultation hcn LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = hcn.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE hcn.deleted = 0 AND hcn.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY hcn.consultation_date DESC, hcn.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_health_consultation SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
